newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan three-month NCDs average yield at 6.585 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan three-month NCDs average yield at 6.585 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank issued T$3 billion in three-month negotiable certificates of deposit on Thursday at an average yield of 6.585 percent, a central bank official said.
The range of the bids was between 6.400 and 6.750 percent.
The central bank has said its recent series of NCD issues aimed to absorb banking system's extra money, but not to dampen stock market turnover as many analysts have asserted.
